trainable: MBConv blocks 36-38 and conv_head; all BatchNorm affine parameters and running statistics frozen
pooling: C5 stride-32 valid-area-weighted average, including fractional boundary cells
augmentation: none; frozen prefix exact BF16 spatial cache
precision: BF16 encoder convolutions and exact BF16 prefix cache; FP32 pooling, standardization, head and loss
optimizer: Adam with constant learning rates, no optimizer weight decay
initialization: Each fold: train-fit-only scaler and weighted L2 logistic head, C=0.001 fixed from prior baseline. Final fit: all cleaned train. Frozen fitted scaler remains fixed during finetuning.
loss: mean weighted BCE with positive weight=n_negative/n_positive from fit rows, plus ||head_weight||^2/(2*C*n_fit); intercept and encoder unpenalized; no oversampling
selection: Among epochs 1-6, largest mean held-fold negative rejection at empirical full sensitivity; then mean AP; then earlier epoch. Epoch 0 recorded as reference, excluded from finetuned-epoch selection.
final_fit: Reset pretrained encoder and all-train logistic head; train entire cleaned train for selected epoch count without validation monitoring
threshold_scope: Clean development validation thresholds and metrics use the same labels, after all model selection; no official test or cascade evaluation
